title: Catch-up spool controller owes the digest refusal keystone that replaced fn-cu-on-end-refuses-a-digest-mismatch: when a batch's spooled chain differs from the claim, fn-csp-step fails the round :digest-mismatch with only (:close), no :local or :journal effect, and the committed cursor unmoved. Witnessed by *cut-bad* in tests/acl2/peer-catchup-tests.lisp, not proved.
